_comment: HTTP transport with env-var TLS paths. Same schema as g8e_gateway_mcp_config.json but references certificate paths via environment variable names instead of literal paths. Useful for containerized deployments where cert paths are injected at runtime. The canonical schema is defined in internal/services/mcp/config.go.

notes: mTLS is required for production access.
Set G8E_CLI_CERT, G8E_CLI_KEY, and G8E_CA_BUNDLE environment variables to the respective file paths.
